sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Starts with assessing current ability to manage third-party risks. In addition, we can assess risks posed by vendors, partners, and service providers. Includes due diligence, and ongoing monitoring.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Reduces exposure to external threats and data breaches. Enhances trust and accountability in supplier relationships. Supports compliance with third-party risk regulations. Improves visibility into supply chain vulnerabilities. Enables proactive risk mitigation and governance.
